intro.name: The setup
intro.text: Three children set out to explore without telling their guardians.

a.name: Outcome A
a.text: They find a rare flower and return before dusk, earning a stern talk.

b.name: Outcome B
b.text: They lose the trail; a search party brings them home frightened.

c.name: Outcome C
c.text: One child falls ill after exposure; a healer treats them and the others reconsider the dare.
